2608.23035.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks
2608.23035.paper_summary: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: \emph{(1)~Sub-agent Collaboration}---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; \emph{(2)~Memory Usage}---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and \emph{(3)~Skill Usage}---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.
2608.23035.paper_summary_zh: 隨著設備上的大型語言模型（LLM）代理演變為個人副駕駛，移動操作系統已成為這一範式的關鍵測試平台，使得嚴格的能力評估變得至關重要。然現有的基準測試分為兩個陣營，每個陣營都有一個關鍵的盲點：以GUI為中心的基準測試測試表面層級的螢幕操作，但忽視了背景工具的使用和長期規劃，而靜態函數調用基準則依賴於與實際運行約束脫節的離線API匹配。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了\textbf{MobilePA-Bench}，這是一個互動的、有狀態的、以工具為中心的基準，用於評估移動規劃代理的工具調用和規劃能力。MobilePA-Bench運行在一個可執行的沙盒中，該沙盒維護實時應用程序數據庫並返回結構化反饋，涵蓋$13$個功能領域和$212$個現實的移動工具。除了基本的工具使用外，它還沿著三個高級維度評估中心規劃代理：\emph{(1)~子代理協作}---將複雜任務分解並將專門工作委派給能幹的子代理；\emph{(2)~記憶使用}---回憶存儲的記憶、用戶檔案和過去的偏好以解決隱含請求；以及\emph{(3)~技能使用}---調用預先打包的複合技能，而不是從頭開始規劃每一步。廣泛的實驗表明，當前的前沿LLM在移動環境中仍然不可靠：在嚴格的工具排序、權限限制和意外運行錯誤下，性能急劇下降。通過將互動的函數調用沙盒與基於證據的驗證相結合，MobilePA-Bench既作為一個實用的診斷基準，也為代理強化學習提供了一個互動的基礎——加速可靠移動代理的發展。
